page: Microsoft Azure EC96ads_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor based on the x86_64 architecture. The host configuration provisions 96 virtual CPUs across 48 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU cache layout includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache per core complex. Hardware instruction extensions feature comprehensive vector and cryptographic capabilities, including AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16 support, alongside AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

System memory capacity totals 672.0 GB, providing an allocation ratio of 7.0 GB per vCPU. Storage architecture features 2577 GB of bundled local solid-state drive capacity, supplemented by compatibility with Azure Premium Storage remote volumes. The instance does not include graphical processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization platform.

Benchmark results demonstrate high computational throughput across parallel tasks. In synthetic compute evaluations, the instance reached a stress-ng multi-core score of 143867.12, categorizing it in the top 10 percent of evaluated server types. Single-core stress-ng performance scored 3023.27, landing within the top 25 percent. In-memory data handling proved equally competitive, with Redis SET operations yielding 106.23 million operations per second, ranking within the upper quartile.

The dense RAM capacity paired with high-bandwidth local SSD storage provides efficient resource concentration for enterprise workloads without the hardware overhead of dedicated acceleration. With robust multithreaded compute, vast memory, and fast ephemeral storage, Microsoft Azure EC96ads_v6 is configured for large in-memory databases, real-time analytics platforms, distributed caching layers, and high-throughput data processing pipelines.
